items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: But I was speaking about Garvin. ... That's the very great Garvan Bushell.

ctx.x: What is Garvin's mother's name, do you know?
North. But I was speaking about Garvin.
The only way he could leave to go up on the show - he was like a godfather of Coleman Hawkins. His mother wasn't going to let him leave to go and Bushell took him. He's alive today.
